tools.name: best_for_task
tools.description: Ranks AI models for one task by performance only (price shown, never used for the rank). Tasks cover text, coding, agents, websites/UI/games/data viz, image generation and editing, video from text or image, video editing, text to speech, transcription, music and embeddings.

tools.name: recommend_models
tools.description: Returns the best-fitting language models for a use case and monthly API budget using the published AgentKernel Fit Score (performance, cost, context, features), with optional privacy and licence requirements.

tools.name: get_model
tools.description: Price, context window, performance/coding/agentic index with rank, licence, privacy, cost for a usage volume and cheaper or open alternatives for one language model.

tools.name: find_models
tools.description: Searches and filters the catalog of language models by name, provider, licence and privacy, sorted by performance, coding, agentic index, price or context.

tools.name: estimate_cost
tools.description: Monthly API cost at base rates for up to five models and a token volume, with the volume translated into words and pages.

tools.name: cheaper_alternative
tools.description: For a model you use today, finds a cheaper model at most five performance-index points lower for the same usage.
